pipeline: YuNet whole-frame proposals at 1x/2x (max1536), FaceLandmarker IMAGE confirmation, semantic skin intersection inside feathered outline excluding eyes/lips
scope: opaque SDR face skin only; no body/hands or identity recognition

models.name: OpenCV Zoo YuNet 2026may dynamic-input export
models.license: MIT; directory LICENSE inspected; no weights redistribution in this block
models.input: OpenCV FaceDetectorYN BGR uint8; explicit 1x/2x sample dimensions; score0.8 NMS0.3 topK5000; additional deterministic NMS0.35 max16
models.output: N x15: x,y,w,h,5 keypoint pairs,score; finite validation; bounds and minimum10px gates
models.runtime: existing OpenCV5.0.0.93 Python research environment; dynamic shape export chosen per upstream README

models.name: MediaPipe Face Landmarker float16 v1
models.license: Detector/FaceMesh model cards declare Apache2.0; bundled blendshape unused; no bundle redistribution in this block
models.input: opaque sRGB RGB uint8 cropped around each independent detector proposal; task handles preprocessing; IMAGE mode, num_faces1, detection/presence thresholds0.5
models.output: 478 normalized landmarks translated into input image pixel coordinates; finite and geometry validation; not a confidence score or visible-skin matte
models.context: no VIDEO mode/previousFrame; explicit radius2 external window only

models.name: MediaPipe SelfieMulticlass256
models.input: face-centered crop2.6x detection size; same verified RGB/normalization contract
models.output: sum channels2+3; smoothstep0.45..0.85; multiplied by confirmed face support; no filled-face fallback

uncertainty: no proposal, missing mesh, partial frame-edge geometry or missing semantic skin returns zero protection; missed faces remain quality failures
data: all footage/model inference local; weights and footage external to repository and plugin
limitations: occluded anatomy may be inferred; semantic intersection is not an occlusion proof
detector threshold crossings may cause temporal color jumps
regression scenes used during selection are not a blind holdout
